newsitem.title: USA: U.S. government classifies set-top as weapon - NYT.
newsitem.headline: U.S. government classifies set-top as weapon - NYT.

text.p: The U.S. government has classified as a weapon a $300 device that sits on top TV sets and is used to browse the World Wide Web, the New York Times reported on Friday.
The daily said the classification would make it difficult for Sony Corp and Philips Electronics NV to get the special export licence needed to sell it overseas.
The government fears that terrorists and criminals could use the device, which encodes the messages its transmits, to commit crimes with electronic impunity, it said.

The government has been negotiating with the industry to try to get it to design these devices to produce codes that can be descrambled by justice authorities if need be. That would make it easier for the industry to export the technology.
The device was designed by Web TV Networks Inc.
